title: Indemnity banding autotriage with pricing signal
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Reduce time-to-approve for standard MSA/DPA redlines by automating indemnity and liability band recommendations and surfacing a pricing delta signal to commercial reps. Scope: Create an autotriage engine that maps clause fingerprints to indemnity bands (A/B/C) and returns a suggested pricing uplift or reserved capacity requirement. Integrate with the Legal intake form and Sales preflight so that small/low-risk deviations can be auto-approved or routed to a fast-track queue. Success metrics: 40% reduction in legal review time for mid-market deals, 30% increase in auto-approved DPA exceptions, measurable uplift in gross margin capture on deals with flagged risk. Out of scope: Changes to master indemnity language and non-negotiable national security clauses. Approach: 1) Define deterministic banding rules from historical redline data and legal heuristics; 2) Build a lightweight scoring function that combines clause fingerprints, counterparty profile, and proposed revenue to recommend a band; 3) Surface a pricing adjustment suggestion (percent uplift or reserve) and a rationale string in the Sales UI; 4) Implement an automated approval rule set for low-risk permutations and a canary fast-path for controlled rollouts. Trade-offs: Conservative banding improves safety but reduces auto-approve rate; more permissive thresholds increase velocity but may push cost to legal/support. Implementation plan: Spec the banding rules with Legal (doc link in comments), prototype scoring in Python using sampled redlines, ship an internal feature flag gated by customer ARR and account tier, instrument telemetry for false-positives/negatives, and run a two-week canary with two AE pods. Rollout: internal-only for 2 weeks -> opt-in beta for select mid-market reps -> full launch after legal sign-off and SLA for manual override. Telemetry & rollout metrics: number of auto-approvals, manual overrides, downstream remediation tasks, legal review time per ticket, revenue-weighted risk exposure. Ops & monitoring: create dashboard in Console with per-rep and per-region auto-approval rates and a regression alert if manual override rate >8% over rolling 7 days.
